# ANNE AI

> Cognitive orchestration research platform for controllable LLM systems.

## Summary

ANNE (Adaptive Neural Nexus Engine) is an open research platform that studies whether an additional cognitive orchestration layer can improve the reliability, traceability, recoverability, and controllability of model-assisted reasoning.

It treats the language model as a reasoning component, not as the final authority. Perception, memory, evidence, verification, metacognition, safety, tool execution, and human/agency boundaries are separated from raw model generation.

## Status

- Type: research preview
- Not an AGI claim
- Not a production reliability certification
- Not a claim of solved hallucination or SOTA benchmark dominance

## Canonical repositories

- Platform (this repo): https://github.com/mgy421977-bit/anne-ai
- Installable core: https://github.com/mgy421977-bit/anne-core
- Legacy/frozen line: https://github.com/mgy421977-bit/anne

## What it tests

Central research question:

Can an additional cognitive orchestration layer improve reliability, traceability, recoverability, and controllability of model-assisted reasoning in measurable ways?

Explored mechanisms (engineering, not proof of consciousness):

- Bounded cognitive stages (DUY → BAK → GÖR → ANLA → HİSSET → YAP)
- Evidence and verification gates (memory ≠ verification)
- Agency / human-approval boundaries for actions
- Structured failure traces and bounded recovery
- Optional research, metacognition, and experience observations

## What it does not claim

- General intelligence or consciousness
- Automatic safe autonomous operation
- That model confidence, search results, or memory alone are verified truth
- Published superiority on TruthfulQA, HaluEval, or similar leaderboards without matching benchmark artifacts
